firstPrint.blocker: The source page replaces one current ZIP, publishes no historical snapshot URLs, and the PDF states that prior fiscal-year rates are updated when charge-off amounts change.

fetchNotes: The www.sba.gov asset URL linked by the official page returned HTTP 404; the page redirects to legacy.sba.gov, where the same official relative path returned the ZIP.

The PDF directly defines the rate as fiscal-year charge-off amount divided by unpaid principal balance at fiscal year end, so the concept, denominator, and percent scale are explicit rather than derived from mismatched files.
The artifact is PDF, not XLS/XLSX, and cannot be served by the existing irs-soi-pub1304 xlrd parser.
